turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. Owen found out about a zero from the gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
Thanks for coming in.
You asked for this meeting, Hale. I'm waiting for an answer to mine.
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk. Start with the zero, and with what you had in hand when you entered it.
How has his semester been at home?
My home isn't the subject, Hale. Why are you asking me that instead of answering what I asked?
He seems tired in class lately.
"Seems tired." That's an impression, Hale, not a document. He works twenty hours a week and he's seventeen, so what does his being tired have to do with a zero?
I know he works at the grocery store.
Then you know he carries a job and a full course load, and you still entered a zero. What do you have on the essay itself?
The essay came in on time, which was good.
It came in on time, and then it got a zero. Say what happened in between, Hale.
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." Concerns about what, on what basis, and did you speak to Owen before you entered a zero?
The school's checker flagged it.
That's a machine's guess, Hale. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect." Then why did one of them decide Owen's mark before anyone spoke to him?
I also looked at the version history.
I'm writing that down. What does the version history show, Hale, and on which dates?
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late" is an adjective, Hale, and I don't trust those. Give me the exact time, and tell me what "created" means, because a file can be created long before anyone finishes writing in it.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." Which times, and how big? Writing that moves from one file to another isn't proof of anything, Hale, so show me the dates.
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward." After you entered the zero? And what did Owen say, in his words, not yours?
He had trouble explaining it.
"Trouble explaining it." He's seventeen, he'd already seen a zero on his phone, and you asked him afterward. So you decided first and asked questions later.
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
Then withdraw the zero, Hale. Intentions aren't a document.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, apologize to Owen for how he found out, or I'm going to the principal's office when we're done.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not in your chair, Hale, and I won't be answering that. I've told you what I want. Withdraw the zero.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
Not while the zero is sitting in the gradebook, Hale. Withdraw it first. And is anything on his record right now?
It would be at lunch, in my room.
You didn't answer what I asked about his record. And at lunch, in your room, who else is there? Owen isn't doing anything in front of other students.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." Held up to what, and who decides? Nothing goes on his record, full stop, and I want that in writing without an "if" in it.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
"Put it in an email yourself, Hale. My terms haven't changed: the zero comes off, and nothing goes on his record.
Thanks for your time.
We're not done, Hale. The zero is still in the gradebook and I have nothing in writing about his record. What are you doing about both?
